title: Vulnerability management and adversarial testing gates
workflow: Inventory exposed services, dependencies, APIs and infrastructure
Schedule authorized secure code review, SAST/DAST and penetration testing
Validate finding reproducibility and rate actual business impact
Apply remediation or qualified time-bound risk exception
Rerun relevant tests and capture real tool outputs
Block release when critical unresolved risks violate risk threshold
invariants: Do not publish false zero-vulnerability claims from an unexecuted scan
Penetration testing must be authorized and isolated from real customer funds
Prioritize cross-tenant IDOR, privilege bypass, session replay and money-flow manipulation
A waived P0 financial regulatory block cannot be treated as security exception
Supply-chain versions and fixes must be traceable
Sensitive report access is scoped and logged
Findings stay open until independently verified closure
acceptance_tests: Mock financial command cannot be forged by channel client
Fixed vulnerable dependency shows verified new version
independent_gate: CISO authorization, actual scanner/testing infrastructure, recorded findings and qualified retest evidence.
